records.title: 10-K
records.text: Ocean Transportation revenue increased $411.8 million, or 13.1 percent, during the year ended December 31, 2022, compared with the year ended December 31, 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Ocean Transportation: The Company’s container volume in the Hawaii service in the fourth quarter 2022 was 13.0 percent lower year-over-year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: As of December 31, 2022, the Company had $642.1 million of unused capacity under the revolving credit facility, with a maturity date of March 31, 2026.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The decrease was primarily driven by lower other terminal revenue, lower lift volume and higher operating costs.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Logistics: In the fourth quarter 2022, operating income for the Company’s Logistics segment was $12.8 million, or $2.0 million lower compared to the level achieved in the fourth quarter 2021.
